The House Bill 324 By: Representatives Martinez of Committee on Governmental Affairs offers the 111th, Hilton of the 48th, Rice of the 139th, Donatucci of the 105th, Chastain of the 7th, and others following substitute to HB 324:
A BILL TO BE ENTITLED AN ACT
To amend Chapter 2 of Title 21 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, relating to primaries and elections generally, so as to provide for preferential treatment during advance voting and during certain hours on election day to voters who are blind, deaf, an amputee, pregnant, accompanied by children of five two years of age or younger, or accompanied by children with special needs regardless of age; to provide for related matters; to repeal conflicting laws; and for other purposes.
BE IT ENACTED BY THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY OF GEORGIA:
SECTION … as follows: "21-2-385.1. During the period of advance voting established pursuant to subsection (d) of Code Section 21-2-385, each elector who is 75 years of age or older, blind, deaf, an amputee, pregnant, accompanied by one or more children of five two years of age or younger, accompanied by one or more children with special needs regardless of the age of such
child, or who is disabled and requires assistance in casting an absentee ballot in person at the registrar's office, absentee ballot clerk's office, or other locations as provided for in Code Section 21-2-382, 21-2-382 shall, upon request to a designated office employee or other individual, be authorized to vote immediately at the next available voting compartment or booth without having to wait in line if such location utilizes direct recording electronic voting systems or … wait in line, as follows: "21-2-409.1. On election day between the hours of 9:30 A.M. and 4:30 P.M., each elector who is 75 years of age or older, blind, deaf, an amputee, pregnant, accompanied by one or more children of five two years of age or younger, accompanied by one or more children with special needs regardless of the age of such child, or who is disabled and requires assistance in voting as authorized by Code Section 21-2-409, shall, upon request to … booth without having to wait in line. Notice of the provisions of this Code section shall be prominently displayed in the voting place."
SECTION 3. All laws and parts of laws in conflict with this Act are repealed.
